payload.title: Test token-authenticated target-VPS Retina/Qwen -> UnifiedDB/EAP memory reflex with Frank experience dose-response
payload.work_clay: Build a matched H1/proxy differential on the final Frank v0.1 target VPS connecting visual evidence to the existing UnifiedDB Emergent Assembly Preprocessor. Frozen fixtures may directly isolate on-VPS Retina/Qwen/EAP mechanics. Every live remote/local visual source must follow secure transport -> API token authentication -> request/session/provenance binding -> typed multimodal ingress -> Retina/Qwen/MVC. Produce provenance-bound PerceptualMemorySeed receipts from known/unknown/wrong/stale visual states, resolve only admissible current UnifiedDB refs, compile bounded EAP ActiveAssemblies, then compare QWEN_ONLY, QWEN_PLUS_DIRECT_EXACT_FTS_MEMORY, PAR_RAW_QWEN_SEED, PAR_PROJECTED_QWEN_SEED and EAP-guided active-sensing variants. Independently manipulate Frank-specific target-relevant prior experience using N={0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64} independent provenance-bound Frank episodes by default, extending geometrically if useful; hold Qwen pretrained knowledge/model/runtime constant and report N_onset, N_robust, N_90 and N_harm. One experience point is one independent observed episode with evidence/context/outcome; correlated frames do not inflate N. Run exact-recurrence, state-variant, relational-transfer, novel-entity, conflicting-experience and irrelevant SHAM_N regimes where fixtures permit. Report API/transport-inclusive and on-VPS-only latency. Explicitly inject wrong seeds, shuffled graph, stale epoch/hash, similar changed identities, contradictory memory and unknown near-neighbors. Retrieved memory remains context-only and cannot override sensor evidence or mint GWT/effect authority.
payload.reason_clay: The target VPS is now the final v0.1 embodiment and the owner-fixed Frank identity is accepted binary+state lineage with a mandatory full token-authenticated API. Therefore PAR is only deployable if live perceptual memory seeding survives the actual API/session/provenance boundary. Existing EAP microsecond-class subpaths and real local Qwen target-host execution make a co-resident associative reflex plausible, but only target-VPS end-to-end rows can decide whether its overhead is negligible. The experience-dose factorial is still mandatory because otherwise gains can be confounded by pretrained Qwen knowledge, cache warming, generic context or exact-recurrence overfit. Strongest risks are wrong-memory confirmation bias, API/transport cost and non-monotonic harm from stale/conflicting experience.
payload.completion_clay: A reproducible target-VPS report gives secure transport/auth/session/ingress latency for live paths, on-VPS seed-resolution and EAP cost, sensor/client-to-ActiveAssembly and sensor/client-to-decision p50/p95/p99, text/visual tokens, correctness, memory precision/recall, false familiarity, wrong-memory acceptance, sensor override failures, false GWT ignition, API/service crash-restart-replay and resource shadows. It includes full QWEN_ONLY, DIRECT_MEMORY_N, PAR_EAP_N, PAR_ACTIVE_N and SHAM_N dose curves, reports N_onset/N_robust/N_90/N_harm or N_onset > max_tested_N, and separates recurrence/variant/transfer/novel/conflicting regimes. Live lanes must additionally prove invalid/missing/revoked credentials cannot enter the perceptual-memory path and request/session/provenance survives into seed/assembly/response receipts. It must show whether PAR beats QWEN_ONLY and simpler direct memory at equal N and whether wrong-seed/shuffled/stale controls collapse benefit. Disposition: SUPPORTED, REVISE, REFUTED or NO_CHANGE.
payload.executor_policy: Primary correctness/performance evidence must run on the current Hostinger target VPS. Experience dose uses independent provenance-bound episodes and held-out evaluation; Qwen pretrained knowledge is constant and never counted as Frank experience. Frozen visual fixtures isolate architecture; live sensors must use the token-authenticated Frank API. Never store raw production API tokens. Separate transport/auth/API cost from on-VPS perception/retrieval/reasoning and report full end-to-end. Do not call EAP literally latency-free. Do not wait for planned GPU/storage hardware unless the owner changes target or target-VPS measurements prove a blocker. No paid training.
invalidators: Project owner explicitly changes the final Frank v0.1 target/identity/API contract
A newer executed target-VPS receipt already measures the same visual-seed EAP differential including experience dose-response and API ingress on current artifacts
Current Frank visual path can no longer produce stable evidence-bound entity/state seeds
